faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Whippet?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 25-40 lb (11-18 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a puppy Whippet?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Heart screening needs; Dental disease; Anesthesia sensitivity notes. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.answer: Every 1-2 weeks on the same scale while a Whippet is growing, with the number saved beside vaccine dates.
